answers.question: predict log10 kcat from enzyme sequence and substrate

Q1_previous.note: loop 131, reported with no error bar

Q2_new.note: loop 132, cluster-bootstrapped. 'ci' is on the gain over a constant; 'paired_ci' is on a model-vs-model difference on the SAME folds and is the correct yardstick for a paired change

Q3_changed_and_why.what: the gain acquired a confidence interval

Q3_changed_and_why.why: loop 131 gave it 40 fixed epochs and no early stopping. With nested CV it reaches 1.3867215456859623 against gradient boosting's 1.3768263740087427, CI on the difference [0.009546593688911245, -0.014316574423367572, 0.03452278029788722]
Q3_changed_and_why.verdict: 'the neural network lost' was a TUNING ARTEFACT

Q3_changed_and_why.why: loop 132 said 0.5625 over all sequences; debiased it is 0.8326689633988986
Q3_changed_and_why.verdict: loop 132's ceiling was OVERSTATED and is corrected

Q4_flat.what: the sequence beyond the EC number
Q4_flat.evidence: B4 refit on the EC-median residual: RMSE 1.5386104927315152 against a residual sd of 1.4848906482578186, R2 -0.07366410883972563
Q4_flat.verdict: FLAT AND NEGATIVE -- everything the model knows is in the EC number

IMPLICIT -- same inputs, used differentl.change: pool the embedding over ACTIVE-SITE residues instead of the whole chain
add a mutant flag and substitution count from the sequences already held
normalise the target to 37 C with Q10, rather than feeding temperature
add EC number as an explicit feature

EXPLICIT -- new information.change: temperature and pH parsed from UniProt kinetics free text

plan.mechanism: kcat is set by a few catalytic residues; averaging 320 dims over ~400 residues moves the vector ~1% when 5 residues change, so 18,595 point mutants differing a median 4.5x in kcat are indistinguishable
plan.distinguisher: this changes the READOUT, which is the thing that refutation named as the cause. It is the fix, not a repeat
plan.falsifier: B4 still fails: the EC-median residual is still unlearnable

plan.change: mutant flag and substitution count as features
plan.mechanism: the model cannot resolve a variant, but it can at least be told it is looking at one
plan.distinguisher: adds a COLUMN, not rows; the refutation was about n
plan.falsifier: no change beyond the paired interval

plan.mechanism: kcat(T2) = kcat(T1)*Q10^((T2-T1)/10) removes a known variance component using physics instead of asking the network to learn Arrhenius
plan.distinguisher: that changed the target to a NOISIER one; this changes the target to the same quantity at a common temperature, which cannot add variance
plan.falsifier: target variance does not fall on the subset with a known temperature

plan.change: EC number as an explicit categorical feature
plan.mechanism: B4 shows the EC number carries everything the model has; give it directly rather than via a proxy
plan.distinguisher: different channel: that priced the SUBSTRATE side, this the enzyme's declared chemistry
plan.falsifier: no gain, which would mean ESM already encodes EC fully

plan.mechanism: a larger encoder, once the readout no longer discards the signal it would add
plan.distinguisher: ONLY the fixed readout distinguishes it, so it is refuted unless P1 is accepted AND has actually moved B4
plan.falsifier: gain smaller than the paired interval, as at 8M

bundle.change: the sub-noise items, run and tested as ONE change
bundle.why: each is smaller than the paired interval alone, so alone each is unmeasurable. Removed variance adds where RMSE gains do not
bundle.falsifier: the bundle's paired difference interval contains zero

refuted.predict kcat/KM instead: measured: sd 1.553 against kcat's 1.483, a 10% WORSE target
refuted.more kcat records: loop 133 B5: the binding constraint is missing conditions, not n
refuted.bigger substrate fingerprint: loop 132 A5: substrate is ~15% of the gain
refuted.650M with mean pooling: loop 133 B1: the readout, not the encoder, is what discards it

whole_picture.what_the_model_needs_it_for: the enzyme-capacity constraint v <= kcat*[E]; loop 133 B6 measured the cell's own enzymes as EASIER than average, reaction-weighted 1.1895 against 1.3072

experimental_floor_rmse: loop 129: same protein AND same substrate measured twice, 1.15x median over 101 values
missing_conditions_rmse: loop 133 B5: within (protein, substrate) pairs, 3.26x, because temperature, pH and mutation are not in the file
per_protein_ceiling_rmse: loop 133 B2: a perfect per-protein predictor, after merging near-duplicates and debiasing singletons
mutant_irreducible_rmse: loop 133 B1: 18,595 point-mutant pairs a mean-pooled embedding cannot distinguish

whole_picture.the_uncomfortable_reading: B4 says the sequence adds nothing beyond the EC number. If P1 does not change that, kcat is not predictable from sequence at this data scale, and loop 127's measured-or-flagged-constant is already the right design.

upgrades.change: order by cost, not by predicted gain
upgrades.why: the cheapest accepted unit costs 5 min and the dearest 240. Spending the cheap ones first means the dear ones are only paid for if the cheap ones move B4

upgrades.change: make B4 the stopping rule, not the RMSE
upgrades.why: RMSE can improve while the model still knows nothing the EC number did not. B4 -- learnability of the EC-median residual -- is the only gate that distinguishes those, so it decides whether P5's 4 hours are spent

upgrades.change: price the whole plan by removed variance, not by adding gains
upgrades.why: the accepted units promise 0.34 if gains are added, which would land at 1.0368. Combined by removed variance the plan promises 0.9964. The floor is 0.5137: the additive reading is the one that would have to be walked back

its only distinguisher from the refuted '650M with mean pooling' is P1's fixed readout, so its 240 minutes are conditional on P1 having moved B4. Listing it as a queued item would be pretending that condition is met

upgrades.change: test P3+P4 as ONE change, and report no per-item attribution
upgrades.why: individually each predicts less than the paired interval 0.0488; together 0.0606. Any per-item number read off a joint run would be inside its own noise, which is exactly the loop 120 failure
